sources.title:
3.8K views · 31 reactions | Britton Hill is the highest natural point in the state of Florida, located in Walton County near the Alabama border. It reaches an elevation of just 345 feet above sea level, making it the lowest highest point of any U.S. state.

The site is located within Lakewood Park and is marked by a monument indicating its elevation. Unlike the dramatic peaks found in other states, Britton Hill reflects Florida’s generally flat landscape and low relief.

The surrounding area consists of gently rolling terrain, forests, and rural land typical of the Florida Panhandle. The region’s geography is shaped by sediment deposits and long term erosion rather than tectonic uplift.

Britton Hill demonstrates how elevation can vary greatly across the United States and how even the highest points can reflect local geographic conditions.

#BrittonHill #Florida #WaltonCounty #HighestPoint #USGeography #FlatLandscape #MapFacts #GeographyFacts #DidYouKnow #ViralFacts #fblifestyle | Global Maps
